study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Meijer et al., Journal of Abnormal Psychology, 2024
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Toward Understanding Autism Heterogeneity: Identifying Clinical Subgroups and Neuroanatomical Deviations

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: ABIDE I and ABIDE II combined
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: “We combined the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE) repositories I ... and II ... for all the analyses conducted in the present study.”

answer.ABIDE (I+II): normative modeling (NAI training/test) and autism sample for clustering/classification

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: NAI used to train the normative model (90% train, 10% test); all autistic participants plus 10% NAI used as test set; ABIDE autism sample used for clustering and classification analyses.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: “This resulted in a sample of 690 autistic and 744 non-autistic individuals between 5-64 years who were included in the normative modeling analysis.” “The dataset was split into a training set consisting of 90% of NAI and a test set consisting of all autistic individuals and the remaining 10% of NAI.” “This resulted in a sample of 499 autistic individuals who were included in the clustering analysis.”
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: ABN-2023-0282_Suppl.docx.md: Participants, Paragraph 2; Normative modelling, Paragraph 1

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: NAI sample for normative modeling: 744; training set is 90% of NAI (0.9 x 744 = 669.6, rounded to 670 inferred). Same NAI counts used for CT and subcortical models.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: “This resulted in a sample of 690 autistic and 744 non-autistic individuals ... included in the normative modeling analysis.” “The dataset was split into a training set consisting of 90% of NAI and a test set consisting of all autistic individuals and the remaining 10% of NAI.” “A separate normative model was built for each of the 148 CT ROIs and 23 subcortical ROIs independently.”
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: ABN-2023-0282_Suppl.docx.md: Participants, Paragraph 2; Normative modelling, Paragraph 1

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Age range reported for the normative modeling sample (combined autism and NAI). No mean/SD reported for NAI specifically or training subset.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: “This resulted in a sample of 690 autistic and 744 non-autistic individuals between 5-64 years who were included in the normative modeling analysis.”

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Primary analyses excluded females; normative modeling sample therefore male-only NAI. Training NAI inferred as 90% of 744 (670).
dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: “For primary analyses, we excluded female participants due to scarce availability across sites (N autism=130, N NAI=280) ... This resulted in a sample of 690 autistic and 744 non-autistic individuals ... included in the normative modeling analysis.” “The dataset was split into a training set consisting of 90% of NAI and a test set consisting of all autistic individuals and the remaining 10% of NAI.”
